Write three sentences describing how you can practise unfamiliar English words.
items.explanation:
I can check an unfamiliar word in a reliable dictionary. I can listen to a trusted pronunciation model and practise saying it. I can compare the word with a similar-looking word instead of assuming they sound the same.
